summary: The implementation fully achieves the saved coverage-wrapped pytest classification plan. Runtime collection distinguishes pytest failures from coverage policy failures, keeps coverage facts and term-missing gaps, surfaces failing node IDs/evidence in command and coverage metadata, prefers PYTEST_TEST_FAILURE for coverage-wrapped test failures including the both-facts case, keeps coverage-only shortfalls as COVERAGE_BELOW_THRESHOLD, updates retry prompts to name failing tests instead of asking for already-satisfied coverage work, and exposes the evidence through validation summary and provenance API models. Focused runtime/control/API tests, ruff, mypy, and the full unit suite passed.
